runtime: Swift / SwiftUI; no Ionic or Cordova runtime

environment.device: owned iPad Pro 13-inch (M5) simulator tw_3122_ipad (iOS 26.5), 1032x1376 pt at scale 2

build_type: Debug, ad hoc signed, built without ad units (TW_ADMOB_NATIVE_IOS and TW_ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_IOS empty: no UMP, no Ads SDK start, no ad request); no GoogleService-Info.plist; no TW_WEATHER_PHOTOS_URL
data: read-only GETs to the legacy weather server (weather, geocode, nationwide, warnings) and Google Places predictions; values are those of the capture time
capture: ios/tools/manual/run-manual-capture.sh --no-ads <out> <udid> (ManualUITests.testCaptureTheManual, 41 screenshots); nine selected (journey shots 03, 05, 08, 11, 15, 16, 26, 33, 36) reduced to half size (1032 px wide) and a 256-color palette

source_changes.change: after the capture (review findings CODEX-3124-5, rounds 1 and 2) the ad-unit guard parses Info.plist, requires each key and Google's test app ID (the Debug value) in both modes, both units empty for --no-ads and the test units otherwise; the build settings, test and image reduction are unchanged, so the screenshots stand (the iPhone store run was repeated with the round-1 guard)

after the capture (#3122 widget images) testCaptureTheStoreScreens adds a Home Screen widget step (removeOtherWidgets, addWidget) and shot() skips the ad check on the Home Screen; testCaptureTheManual is unchanged, so the manual screenshots stand
after the capture (review finding CODEX-3124-15) --store runs on a disposable clone of the given simulator; the manual mode is unchanged, so the manual screenshots stand
